sourceText:
Ode To A Holiday Cookie
By: Four Seasons Ho...
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 12:33pm

Ingredients




3 cups flour
1 teaspoon baking powder
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 cup softened butter
1 cup sugar
1 beaten egg
2 tablespoons milk
1/2 cup powdered sugar

Preparation

1 Pre-heat oven to 375 2 Sift together flour, baking powder, and salt. 3 Combine butter and sugar in large mixer bowl and beat until smooth. Beat egg and milk into butter-sugar mixture. 4 Gradually add flour mixture to wet ingredients in mixer-bowl, and beat until the cookie dough pulls-away from the sides of the bowl. 5 Divide the dough into quarters, wrapping each piece in waxed paper, and refrigerate 2 hours. 6 Instead of using flour to prevent sticking, use powdered sugar to roll-out dough to approximately 1/4 inch thickness. Roll each one quarter package at a time, so that dough remains cool while working. 7 Cut into holiday shapes, place one inch apart on greased baking sheet, and bake until cookies turn slightly brown around edges (approximately 10 minutes).

About


Note: This recipe was submitted by Sue Beller to the Four Seasons Hotel Seattle's Ultimate Holiday Cookie Contest.
